name: table_inventory
caption: Processed source-table inventory with one aligned row per dataset: categorical columns as a share of all source columns on the left, and missing feature entries as a share of all source feature entries on the right. Percentages are written beside the marks; axes have separate percentage ranges. PD (circles) and LGD (squares) label the prediction tasks. The inventory precedes prediction-time feature exclusions and fold-fitted encoding; a zero reflects the available processed table, not necessarily complete original records.
